_comment: Single source of truth for the plugin inventory. scripts/gen_docs.py regenerates the marked inventory sections of AGENTS.md and OPENCODE.md from this file; tests/test_doc_sync.py fails the build if either drifts from it, or if a file exists on disk that isn't listed here. Add new skills/commands/agents/memory modules here FIRST, then rerun scripts/gen_docs.py. See docs/manifest.json's own 'tools_excluded_patterns' for what's deliberately left out of the tools inventory (private helpers, __init__.py, README.md).

skills.name: bug-bounty
skills.description: Master workflow — recon to report, all vuln classes, LLM testing, chains

skills.name: bb-methodology
skills.description: Hunting mindset + 5-phase non-linear workflow + tool routing + session discipline

skills.name: web2-recon
skills.description: Subdomain enum, live host discovery, URL crawling, nuclei

skills.name: web2-vuln-classes
skills.description: 24 bug classes with bypass tables (SSRF, open redirect, file upload, Agentic AI)

skills.name: security-arsenal
skills.description: Payloads, bypass tables, gf patterns, always-rejected list

skills.name: web3-audit
skills.description: 10 smart contract bug classes, Foundry PoC template, pre-dive kill signals

skills.name: meme-coin-audit
skills.description: Meme coin rug pull detection, token authority checks, bonding curve exploits, LP attacks

skills.name: report-writing
skills.description: H1/Bugcrowd/Intigriti/Immunefi report templates, CVSS 3.1, human tone

skills.name: triage-validation
skills.description: 7-Question Gate, 4 gates, never-submit list, conditionally valid table

skills.name: credential-attack
skills.description: Password spray methodology — when/why, 4-stage pipeline, mode selection, lockout tactics, legal guardrails

skills.name: mobile-pentest
skills.description: Android/iOS app pentest — runtime-first proxy workflow, APK/IPA decompile, deeplink/WebView bridge injection, SSL pinning bypass

skills.name: cicd-security
skills.description: CI/CD pipeline hunting — GitHub Actions injection, secret exfil, self-hosted runner poisoning, OIDC abuse, supply chain attacks

skills.name: graphql-audit
skills.description: GraphQL hunting — introspection, field suggestions, batching DoS, IDOR via aliasing, injection, auth bypass, depth bombs

commands.name: scope-aggregate
commands.description: /scope-aggregate <program> — pull every in-scope asset across H1/Bugcrowd/Intigriti/YWH/Immunefi

commands.name: memory-gc
commands.description: /memory-gc [--rotate|--purge-backups] — inspect/rotate hunt-memory JSONL files (10MB cap, 3 backups)

commands.name: arsenal
commands.description: /arsenal [tool] — list installed external tools or get an install hint

commands.name: scan-cves
commands.description: /scan-cves <host> — focused nuclei CVE sweep (high/critical) + optional log4j-scan

commands.name: osint-employees
commands.description: /osint-employees <target> — employee names + emails (theHarvester + username-anarchy, opt-in LinkedIn); requires --with-credential-attack

commands.name: breach-check
commands.description: /breach-check <wordlist> — HIBP k-anonymity rank wordlist by real-world breach count

commands.name: spray
commands.description: /spray <url> --mode http-form|oauth|o365|okta --users <f> --passes <f> — password spray with hard guards

agents.name: js-intelligence
agents.description: Mines JS bundles/source maps for hidden endpoints, feature flags, debug routes, leaked config, auth flows

agents.name: vulnerability-intelligence
agents.description: Builds the memory-driven intelligence briefing (tech→vuln affinity, known chains, don't-retry list) before ranking; writes learned failed-patterns/chains back after a hunt

agents.name: hypothesis-engine
agents.description: Synthesizes recon + JS intel + memory + the attack graph into ranked, evidence-backed vulnerability hypotheses before any testing starts

agents.name: report-writer
agents.description: Generates H1/Bugcrowd/Immunefi reports; validates exploitability/impact/evidence first and checks report-outcome acceptance history

agents.name: validation-engine
agents.description: Technical proof gate before validator: reproducibility, proven impact, authorization boundary crossed, clean PoC, duplicate/noise against hunt memory

agents.name: chain-builder
agents.description: Builds A→B→C exploit chains, memory-first (chains.jsonl + lead-board graph before the static table), saves every chain it confirms

agents.name: autopilot
agents.description: Autonomous hunt loop (scope→recon→rank→hunt→validate→report), decision-engine-driven priority scoring, experiment-tracked stop/pivot decisions

agents.name: recon-ranker
agents.description: Scored, confidence-rated attack surface ranking from recon output + hypotheses + the intelligence briefing + lead-board chains, plus Expected Value per Hour per candidate

agents.name: token-auditor
agents.description: Fast meme coin/token rug pull and security analysis

agents.name: credential-hunter
agents.description: Orchestrates wordlist-gen + osint-employees + breach-check; HARD STOPS at spray for human go/no-go

agents.name: research-director
agents.description: Turns the lead board + browser intelligence into an executable, time-boxed research plan with EV/hour ordering, mandatory falsifiers, dependency-aware scheduling, and an explicit SKIPPED negative-space section

tools.name: hunt.py
tools.description: Master hunt orchestrator — chains target selection, recon, scanning, and reporting

tools.name: recon_engine.sh
tools.description: Subdomain + URL discovery pipeline (subfinder/amass/crt.sh/wayback/httpx/nmap/gau), optional nuclei phase

tools.name: vuln_scanner.sh
tools.description: XSS/SQLi/SSTI/MFA/SAML probe pipeline with verified PoC generation

tools.name: validate.py
tools.description: Interactive 4-gate finding validator + CVSS 4.0 scorer + report skeleton; headless via --non-interactive

tools.name: validation_core.py
tools.description: Pure, headless 4-gate validation logic + CVSS 4.0 calculator (dict in/out, zero I/O) — the single implementation validate.py wraps

tools.name: learn.py
tools.description: Fetches recent bug intelligence for a tech stack from GitHub Advisories, NVD CVE API, and HackerOne Hacktivity

tools.name: intel_engine.py
tools.description: On-demand intel fetch for a target — wraps learn.py + HackerOne MCP + hunt memory context

tools.name: scope_checker.py
tools.description: Deterministic scope safety checker — anchored allowlist/blocklist matching before any outbound request

tools.name: scope_aggregator.sh
tools.description: Multi-platform in-scope asset pull (bbscope + bounty-targets-data dump)

tools.name: secrets_hunter.sh
tools.description: trufflehog/noseyparker/gitleaks wrapper for filesystem/git/JS-bundle/GitHub-org secret scanning

tools.name: takeover_scanner.sh
tools.description: dnsReaper/subjack subdomain-takeover scanner with built-in fingerprint-grep fallback

tools.name: cloud_recon.sh
tools.description: S3Scanner + cloud_enum + CloudFail wrapper for public bucket discovery and CloudFlare-bypass origin IPs

tools.name: param_discovery.sh
tools.description: Arjun/x8 hidden-parameter discovery

tools.name: bypass_403.sh
tools.description: byp4xx wrapper + built-in 403/401 bypass matrix (header/method/encoding tricks)

tools.name: cve_scan.sh
tools.description: Focused nuclei CVE-tag sweep + optional log4j-scan

tools.name: external_arsenal.sh
tools.description: Installed-tool registry (~50 tools); other scripts source this for _have <tool>

tools.name: cicd_scanner.sh
tools.description: GitHub Actions workflow scanner (sisakulint wrapper, remote scan)

tools.name: token_scanner.py
tools.description: Deterministic token red-flag scanner for meme coin rug vectors (EVM Solidity + Solana Rust/Anchor)

tools.name: wordlist_engine.sh
tools.description: Company-specific password wordlist generator (cewler crawl + hashcat mutation rules)

tools.name: osint_employees.sh
tools.description: Employee names + email patterns for spray prep (theHarvester + username-anarchy, opt-in CrossLinked)

tools.name: breach_checker.py
tools.description: HIBP k-anonymity wordlist enrichment; ranks passwords by real-world breach count (no API key)

tools.name: spray_orchestrator.sh
tools.description: Password spray with typed-hostname guard + lockout warning + audit log; modes http-form/oauth/o365/okta

tools.name: graphql_audit.sh
tools.description: 7-phase GraphQL audit: introspection, graphw00f fingerprint, clairvoyance field discovery, batching DoS, alias bomb, gqlmap injection, graphql-cop checklist

tools.name: lead_board.py
tools.description: Persistent per-target lead ledger that routes every recon observation to the right hunt-* skill and tracks status so no lead is forgotten; auto chain/hypothesis detection

tools.name: banner.py
tools.description: Shared CLI banner (ASCII logo + gradient) imported by every tool's --help/startup output

tools.name: banner.sh
tools.description: Shell-sourced equivalent of banner.py for the .sh tools

tools.name: h1_idor_scanner.py
tools.description: HackerOne-specific IDOR scanner — probes GraphQL/REST endpoints with two attacker session tokens

tools.name: h1_mutation_idor.py
tools.description: HackerOne mutation-IDOR tester — cross-account report mutation probes (title/status/bounty/assignee changes)

tools.name: h1_oauth_tester.py
tools.description: HackerOne OAuth/CORS/redirect/token-reuse probe suite

tools.name: h1_race.py
tools.description: HackerOne race-condition tester — parallel-threaded GraphQL/REST requests

tools.name: h1_run.sh
tools.description: Hand-edit-and-run orchestrator wiring tokens into h1_idor_scanner/h1_oauth_tester/h1_race

tools.name: hai_browser_recon.js
tools.description: DevTools console snippet that intercepts Hai's (HackerOne AI) GraphQL requests to map its API surface

tools.name: hai_payload_builder.py
tools.description: Generates LLM/agentic-AI attack payloads (prompt injection, exfil channels, ASCII smuggling) by category

tools.name: hai_probe.py
tools.description: Probes HackerOne's Hai AI assistant via api.hackerone.com for IDOR/prompt-injection/fingerprinting

tools.name: memory_gc.py
tools.description: CLI for memory/rotation.py — inspect/rotate/purge hunt-memory JSONL files

tools.name: mindmap.py
tools.description: Generates a pre-hunt reconnaissance checklist/mind-map Markdown file for a target

tools.name: multipart_mutator.py
tools.description: Builds and optionally sends mutated multipart/form-data upload requests (file-upload bypass fuzzing)

tools.name: sneaky_bits.py
tools.description: Invisible Unicode steganography encode/decode (variation selectors) for prompt-injection PoCs

tools.name: target_selector.py
tools.description: Fetches HackerOne + bounty-targets-data program listings and selects/saves top targets to hunt

tools.name: waf_encoder.py
tools.description: WAF-bypass payload encoder — URL/unicode-escape/HTML-entity/SQL-comment-injection transforms

tools.name: waf_response_analyzer.py
tools.description: Classifies WAF-block vs application responses; diffs and calibrates baselines for bypass confirmation

tools.name: zero_day_fuzzer.py
tools.description: curl-based HTTP fuzzing probes against a target or a recon-dir's URL list

tools.name: zendesk_idor_test.py
tools.description: Zendesk-specific IDOR/broken-access-control tester — cross-org API data access probes

tools.name: auth_session.py
tools.description: Auth-session layer — loads credentials once (env vars, .env, or flags) and plumbs them through a hunt

tools.name: credential_store.py
tools.description: Secure credential store — loads auth credentials from a gitignored .env file, never persisted elsewhere

tools.name: dashboard.py
tools.description: Live ANSI TUI dashboard for /recon and /hunt phase progress

tools.name: recon_adapter.py
tools.description: Canonical recon output normalizer — reads either recon_engine.sh's nested or a flat directory format

tools.name: browser_recon.py
tools.description: Browser intelligence layer — Playwright-optional source-map recovery + hidden-endpoint discovery for SPA targets; cookies/storage/auth-header values are never stored, only a one-way value_fingerprint (sha256[:16]) for cross-host credential-sharing detection

tools.name: director.py
tools.description: Research Director — turns lead-board + browser-intelligence + attack-graph leads into an executable, falsifiable, time-boxed plan via priority_score()/expected_value_per_hour(); writes recon/<target>/hunt-plan.md + a hunt-plan.json sidecar for cross-process replan

tools.name: fingerprint.py
tools.description: Target Intelligence (Phase 3) — consolidates Phase 1 browser/*.json + recon_engine.sh's httpx tech-detect output into recon/<target>/fingerprint.json (framework/version/confidence, infra CDN/WAF, api_style, CVEs from tech_attack_matrix.json); syncs tech_stack into memory_dir/targets/<target>.json for director.py's load_tech_stack()

tools.name: tech_attack_matrix.json
tools.description: Static per-framework/version-range vulnerability weight + CVE table (extends mindmap.py's TECH_CHECKS); read by fingerprint.py and optionally passed to priority_score() as a cold-start technology_match floor

memory.name: pattern_db.py
memory.description: Cross-target pattern learning — successful techniques indexed by vuln class + tech stack (JSONL)

memory.name: vuln_intelligence.py
memory.description: CANONICAL decision engine — priority_score(), expected_value_per_hour(), duplicate_or_noise_check(), hypothesis_calibration(), tech→vuln affinity, self-learning acceptance-rate blending

memory.name: experiment_memory.py
memory.description: Granular per-payload-attempt log beneath patterns/failed_patterns — payload_category_affinity(), should_stop() (5-min-rule), suggest_pivot()

memory.name: audit_log.py
memory.description: Append-only outbound-request audit log, rate limiter, and circuit breaker for autopilot sessions

memory.name: rotation.py
memory.description: Size-based JSONL rotation (10MB cap, keep 3 backups), auto-fired on every append

memory.name: schemas.py
memory.description: Schema validation for all hunt-memory JSONL entry types (schema_version for migrations)

memory.name: finding_state.py
memory.description: Finding lifecycle state machine — SUSPECTED→TESTING→VALIDATED→CONFIRMED→REPORT_READY (+REJECTED), append-only transition log

memory.name: finding_score.py
memory.description: Ranks raw scanner-output lines using vuln_intelligence.priority_score() as the single scoring formula — not yet wired to brain.py

memory.name: attack_graph.py
memory.description: Typed capability graph (Asset/Endpoint/Credential/Capability/Boundary/Impact nodes) built from lead-board leads + browser intelligence, including cross-host bridging via matching cookie/storage/header value_fingerprint across two hosts; bounded N-leg DFS path search with provenance and contradiction-aware edge confidence; path_score() reuses vuln_intelligence's impact/time tables; top_paths() wired into director.py's build_plan() alongside board/browser-intel leads
